runs.name: EnerNorth Industries Inc.; formerly AMEX ENY and Frankfurt EPW1, OTC symbol ENYNF, a junior oil and gas producer in the Western Canada Sedimentary Basin (Alberta, Saskatchewan, British Columbia and Ontario), an Ontario company based in Toronto, a 20-F filer with a June year reporting in Canadian dollars, SEC CIK 0001049021; formerly Energy Power Systems Ltd, renamed 2003; the Supreme Court of Canada denied leave in the Oakwell litigation 2007-01-18, leaving a judgment of about CDN $6.8M; Notice of Intention under the BIA 2007-02-09; Assignment in Bankruptcy 2007-03-20; struck from AMEX by Form 25-NSE 2007-04-10; nothing filed with the SEC since; the 20-F names no rival
runs.box: TOO HARD (NATURE) AT Q1; integrity facts recorded, not judged
runs.entry: Price: **no usable public quote** (aggregators flagged and not used: stoxray ENYNF "Last price 0.00 USD" with a "Jan 07" stamp; a Simply Wall St snippet of US$4,000 market cap; Yahoo "symbol may be delisted"; OTC Markets down for maintenance at fetch). Shares: about 4,293,000 (6-K of 2007-03-20, acc 0001049021-07-000016; 4,272,009 at 2006-06-30 on the 20-F cover), by hand, `tools/run.py` and `Screens/cover_shares.py` both refused the name. Sovereign **4.19%** (Bank of Canada long benchmark `BD.CDN.LONG.DQ.YLD`, 2026-10-14); the protocol's table has no CAD row, said so. Filings read: 20-F FY2006, 0001049021-06-000046; 20-F FY2002, 0001049021-02-000052 (FY1998 to FY2002 selected data); the 6-K interim statements to 2006-12-31, 0001049021-07-000009 (unaudited, "An accounting firm has not reviewed or audited"); 6-Ks 0001049021-07-000002, -000011, -000013, -000015 to -000017; 8-K 0001049021-06-000071 (AMEX deficiency); 25-NSE 0001143313-07-000057. Primary documents after 2007 searched: EDGAR (nothing), the company website (a parked page), aggregators; the trustee's estate file, SEDAR+ and the federal insolvency records not reached. The brief departed in three stated places: lines of evidence derived by the analyst from the 20-F's Items 4, 3.D and 5; competitors from the 20-F (it names none, none chosen); a paragraph on a filer with no current filings. **Q1 TOO HARD (NATURE)**: an assignment in bankruptcy, delisting and no account of any business since the unaudited statements to 2006-12-31; the NATURE label and a re-look condition (a new audited statement, or a filed document showing a business carried on under these shares after 2007-03-20) confessed as CONVENTIONS of the run; the analyst argues OUT as a defensible alternative reading in the run's last section. Q2 to Q12 not reached. **Integrity facts recorded, not judged:** two directors held 11.24% and 6.49% of the acquisition target 1211115 Alberta, whose CDN$650K advance became a demand note secured on the company's unencumbered assets; payments to a firm controlled by a director's daughter; the KGPL shares sold to the company's own Barbados subsidiary for a demand note; the company's Ontario defence that Singapore "does not adhere to the Rule of Law", rejected; several 2007 6-Ks signed with 2006 dates. Facts beneath the stop: a loss in every year FY1998 to FY2006; equity rising only on share sales, CDN$43.8M paid in against a CDN$41.2M deficit at 2006-12-31; three consolidations, 48 old shares to one; US GAAP equity CDN$0.87M at June 2006 against CDN$4.54M Canadian GAAP after ceiling-test depletion; a going-concern note; owner cash (operating cash less oil and gas spending) FY2002 to FY2006 CDN$(4.94M), 0.27M, (4.79M), 3.62M, (7.32M), average CDN$(2.63M). COMPUTATION on the filed record (the sign-changing series taken as the no-growth case alone; net debt CDN$6.61M including the Oakwell judgment less the $1.5M posted): value about **CDN$-16.16** a share all-equity (CDN$-14.64 equity-only; CDN$-14.68 all-equity without the judgment), fair about **CDN$-7.66 all-equity** (CDN$-6.14 equity-only), against no usable quote; not armed, the box being TOO HARD at Q1. Contamination declared by the analyst: the session-context commit subjects including the CTBG dark-filer close at Q1 TOO HARD (NATURE), which bears on method; the AYI and ARCB research-folder names in `git status`; the memory index lines; none used; no blind-listed file opened, listed or searched. Commits 12c596b2, c1ab0e3f, two. Position note filled at the fold: not held (`PORTFOLIO.md` carries no line for ENYN or EnerNorth). Citations: the analyst's `check_ids.py` PASS; the dispatcher's `verify_cites.py` 25 ids, no phantom, no E-id, 17 quoted fragments, no slip. No tracked research file over 200 KB. check_framework PASS. **For the operator:** the analyst's gaps: (1) no box or label rule for a bankrupt or dark filer, so two analysts could close the same name OUT and TOO HARD (the second such name today after CTBG); (2) the protocol's sovereign table has no CAD row; (3) the fair-price definition does not say what to report when every case is negative, and an alert on a negative fair price would mean nothing. Could not get: the trustee's estate file, SEDAR+, the federal insolvency records, the finding cost and any reserve report; the interim MD&A downloaded, not read.
runs.narr: Q1 TOO HARD (NATURE): a bankrupt filer, an Assignment in Bankruptcy 2007-03-20 after the Supreme Court of Canada left the Oakwell judgment of about CDN$6.8M standing, struck from AMEX 2007-04-10, no account of any business since the unaudited statements to 2006-12-31; the NATURE label and a re-look on a new audited statement confessed as CONVENTIONS of the run, OUT argued as a defensible alternative. Integrity facts recorded, not judged: directors holding stakes in an acquisition target whose advance became a secured demand note, payments to a director's daughter's firm, assets sold to the company's own subsidiary for a demand note. A loss in every year FY1998 to FY2006, equity only from share sales. COMPUTATION on the filed record: value about CDN$-16.16 a share all-equity, fair about CDN$-7.66 all-equity (CDN$-6.14 equity-only), no usable quote; not armed. Framework gaps for the operator: no rule for a bankrupt or dark filer (second today after CTBG); no CAD row in the sovereign table; no reporting line for an all-negative fair price.
